verdict.rationale: Loops ships a CLI, SDKs and an MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any opt-out setting, flag or privacy control for telemetry. The docs cover only API, CLI, MCP, email and pricing features, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
